meta.name: caveman-stats
meta.description: Show real token usage and estimated savings for the current session. Reads directly from the Claude Code session log — no AI estimation. Triggers on /caveman-stats. Output is injected by the mode-tracker hook; the model itself does not compute the numbers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 实时查看本次会话的token用量和节省成本
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想实时掌握当前会话的token用量与成本节省。
copy.tagline_en: See real token usage and estimated savings for the current session.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to keep an eye on how many tokens your session uses and how much it saves.

howto.what: 执行 /caveman-stats 时，Claude 显示当前会话的真实 token 用量与估算节省。数据直接取自 Claude Code 会话日志，不经 AI 估算；结果由 mode-tracker hook 注入输出，模型本身不参与计算。
howto.when: 当用户输入 /caveman-stats 命令时触发。输出由 mode-tracker hook 注入，用户立即看到数字。

say.note: 立即显示 token 用量与节省估算。

say.text: 统计本会话的 token 消耗
显示当前会话的节省情况
say.note: 如存在估算，会同时列出规则开销与净值。

howto.what_en: On /caveman-stats, Claude displays real token usage and estimated savings for the current session, read directly from the Claude Code session log (no AI estimation). The mode-tracker hook injects the output; the model itself does not compute numbers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user runs /caveman-stats. The mode-tracker hook injects the output immediately.

say_en.note: Shows token usage and savings immediately.

say_en.text: Count tokens used in this session
Show savings estimate for this session
say_en.note: Lists rule overhead and net if available.
